entities.summary: Nobuo Kojima was a Japanese writer prominent in the postwar era. He is most readily associated with other writers of his generation, such as Shōtarō Yasuoka, who describe the effects of Japan's defeat in World War II on the country's psyche. Nobuo Kojima was a journalists & chroniclers from Gifu (1915-02-28, Gifu–2006-10-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
